scripts.speaker: Equipment Reform PR Agent
scripts.text:
Hello, adventurer!
Are you unhappy with your equipment now?
Don't you want to try a new modification than just any other normal method?
Join the Regenschirm Institute!
Let's go.
Listen to the explanation.
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Equipment Reform PR Agent
scripts.text: Good! Other facilities in the institute are confidential and are not accessible, so we will guide you on a special path where you outsiders can enter!

scripts.speaker: Equipment Reform PR Agent
scripts.text:
All around the world research is being conducted at the Regenschirm Institute to modify weapons, armor, accessories and other equipment items...
We're still collecting data and researching modifications, so we need a lot of adventurer's equipment to increase our modification research.

scripts.speaker: Equipment Reform PR Agent
scripts.text: Research is ongoing, so please look forward to the addition of multiple new equipment as soon as it is completed!

scripts.speaker: Equipment Reform PR Agent
scripts.text: If you're interested later, come back!

scripts.speaker: Torus
scripts.text:
Huh? Do you have anyone else to see on our team other than the team leader?
Then that's me~
I am in charge of Enchants.
Let's see what you got?
Modified OS Weapon Enchant
Quit

And we need the research.

scripts.text:
Ah, we've come this far, but our team's research is still lacking in experiments.
I'll improve it a bit next time and get the captain's permission, then let's proceed.
Okay?

scripts.text:
Come on.
It's a low-budget lab, so it's always like this.
My assistants and I refine the gemstones used in this lab. For a fee.
View the exchange list

scripts.speaker: Grid

scripts.speaker: Grid
scripts.text:
As we see in our research, the materials are very rare. There are adventurers hired by our team, but the material is not comparable to the amount we need.
So when the adventurers came with the materials, they decided to provide the corresponding research value.

scripts.speaker: Grid
scripts.text:
Luckily, we do the research and adventurers who come to us provide materials to use our technology.
If you want to modify something you only need to bring the presented materials.

scripts.speaker: Grid
scripts.text: You're an adventurer, so you know what that means?

scripts.speaker: Grid
scripts.text: If you need anything, come again.

scripts.speaker: Champ
scripts.text:
Finally, I talked to an adventurer and asked him to confirm my research, was that you?
Unfortunately, our team hasn't done enough to get out there yet.

scripts.speaker: Champ
scripts.text:
It's still incomplete.
I'll see you next time I get permission from the captain.

We're proud of this lab.

scripts.speaker: Director
scripts.text:
...Come on.
You may have heard the explanation when you came, but to briefly introduce you to this place, there is still a long way to go. We are working on converting many weapons, armor, accessories, etc. into something different.

scripts.speaker: Director
scripts.text: It is essential to cut the refine of the equipment to be converted, but it is a labor for greater power.

scripts.speaker: Director
scripts.text:
Research is ongoing, so it is not known when and where something will suddenly be completed and offered to adventurers.
It is... As soon as the data is collected, it will be somehow.

scripts.speaker: Director
scripts.text:
And this time, Team Licht achieved it.
If you're interested, check out what research was done.

scripts.speaker: Director
scripts.text: Everyone likes it quiet, so don't talk too loud.
